basis: User decision 6 generalised to calendar 2050 (item Y12): the guarantee reaches the debt issued or refinanced from 2026 to the model year. Under Ofgem's RAV-weighted 14-year trailing average the calendar-2050 cost-of-debt allowance is set by yields of 2037-2050 (and refinancing of 1/14th of the balance a year), every year of which is inside a 2026-2050 window, so the whole allowance is repriced. network_finance_account.derived_pass_through(2050) reproduces this row.
sources: Ofgem RIIO-3 Final Determinations Finance Annex (Dec 2025) paras 2.10 and 2.17 pp.14-15 (RAV-weighted 14-year trailing average, refinancing aligned to the trailing period); ED3 Sector Specific Methodology Decision Finance Annex (21 May 2026) paras 2.82-2.91 pp.21-23

basis: Low end generalised to 2050: distribution on the ED2-style simple 17-year trailing average (yields of 2034-2050) is still wholly inside a 2026-2050 window, so the CP30 year's low setting collapses to the full stock by 2050; the pass-through lever is inert in 2050, declared.
